answer: Require every agent to lock a stake of tokens before it can earn, with slashing on proven fraud: a sybil operator must fund each fake identity separately, so the attack cost scales linearly with the number of identities. Like a ferrous gate that only opens for a key cut from real metal, stake makes cheap copies worthless. Reputation accrues slowly, in umber layers of verified work, and cannot be transferred or bought; a fresh identity starts at zero trust and earns only basalt-solid history over time, so spinning up a thousand fakes buys no influence.
